press_references.value: Minister of Energy and Finance engage Karpower on legacy debt

legal_proceedings.description: Ghana's Minister for Energy and Minister for Finance met with Karpowership to address legacy debt and prevent a possible shutdown of Karpowership's operations in Ghana. The meeting focused on resolving financial challenges related to outstanding payments.
Karpowership has threatened to suspend electricity supply due to an outstanding debt of $379 million owed by the government, potentially leading to a power crisis.
